findings.highlight: who had inherited Magic Circuits perfected over generations
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術回路として完成された一族の作品
findings.governingReading: The family's creation has been perfected as a Magic Circuit; it is this creation that they believe can accomplish their aim.
findings.explanation: A family creation perfected as a Magic Circuit becomes someone who inherited circuits perfected over generations. The English adds an inheritance mechanism and changes what was perfected.

findings.governingReading: Two months precede the war’s start.
findings.explanation: The Holy Grail War becomes the Holy Grail starting.
